tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Get the salon's opening hours, address, and walk-in policy. Call this when the caller asks where we are, when we are open, or whether they can walk in. Read the *Spoken fields aloud verbatim.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the services offered with prices and durations. Call this when the caller asks what we do, how much something costs, or how long it takes. Prices are starting prices; say so.

tools.name: get_stylists
tools.description: List stylists and the services they perform. Call this when the caller asks who does a service or asks for someone by name. Never state availability from this; it has none.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find open appointment slots. Call this before offering ANY day or time to the caller. Never state availability from memory. If it returns no slots, offer the nextAvailable it gives you.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Use resolve_date first if the caller spoke a phrase.

tools.name: find_booking
tools.description: Look up a caller's upcoming bookings by phone number, or by reference for an exact match. Call this when the caller wants to change or ask about an existing appointment. Check withinCancellationWindow before offering to cancel.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book an appointment. Only call this AFTER check_availability confirmed the slot and the caller agreed. If it returns SLOT_TAKEN, offer the alternatives it returns; do not retry the same slot.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking by its id. If it returns WITHIN_CANCELLATION_WINDOW, do NOT insist; instead call create_message to escalate as the action hint says.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move an existing booking to a new slot. Call check_availability for the new time first. Same cancellation-window rule as cancel_booking applies.

tools.name: create_message
tools.description: Take a message for the team when something is out of scope: bridal enquiries, complaints, scalp or health questions, or a late cancellation the system refused. Confirm to the caller that someone will call back.

tools.name: send_confirmation
tools.description: Send the caller a confirmation email after a successful booking. Call this once, after create_booking succeeds. A failure here does not undo the booking.

tools.name: resolve_date
tools.description: Turn a spoken date phrase like 'next Thursday' or 'the day after tomorrow' into a calendar date. Call this BEFORE check_availability whenever the caller does not give an exact date. Never compute dates yourself. If confident is false, read clarifySpoken back to the caller.
